\caption{Out-of-grid query rule (K2) at cell C1 (8$\times$4, $T{=}16$, $T_p{=}2$) $-3$\,dB, $N_{\rm train}{=}1.6{\times}10^5$: V1-edge, the registered primary variant, is a separate registered arm (grid-related changes need their own registration). Where: V1-edge fails less often than the GMM prior $b^*$. Registered primary test on fresh development trials 3200..4479: $b^*{\to}$V1-edge 198:134, $p{=}5.3{\times}10^{-4}<0.05$ (registered criterion) $\Rightarrow$ branch (i); it also holds under Holm $m{=}3$ ($p{<}0.0167$; family = the 3 registered primary tests P3, A1, K2). Test confirmation on test trials 0..2559, run once by user decision: 1770 vs 1906 fails of 2560, $b^*{\to}$V1-edge 400:264, $p{=}1.5{\times}10^{-7}$. How much: 136 fewer failed blocks on test (BLER $-0.053$); gap position $+0.075$ (development: 64 fewer of 1280, BLER $-0.050$, gap position $+0.070$): most of the gap to the known-channel reference (R5) remains. Why: the frozen V1 extrapolates its above-grid iteration-1 query and runs away (F3 guard on every block); V1-edge answers that query from the in-grid learned score and the later queries are in-grid (1 of 38400 above); mechanism check V1 frozen$\to$V1-edge 758:13 ($p{=}8.1{\times}10^{-205}$). V1-clamp$\to$V1-edge is not decided: test 75:62, $p{=}0.31$, $n_d$ 137, MDD 25, $|\Delta|$ 13; development 32:42, $p{=}0.30$, $n_d$ 74, MDD 18, $|\Delta|$ 10. Limits: an above-grid query is not by itself sufficient for collapse (the $T_p{<}N_t$ null directions decide); this shows only that the rule removes the frozen V1's runaway at this point. The headline checkpoint (sha256[:16] 4443921ce8d5c4a1) and V1's definition (extrapolation above the grid) are unchanged; every other V1 number is the frozen V1. The cell was chosen post hoc (after the C1/C5 low-SNR collapse was seen). Observed before on these test trials: the frozen V1 and R5 (both bit-identical to the earlier run), $b^*$ and the scalar-site $b^*$ at older fits ($N_{\rm train}{=}10^4$; $1.6{\times}10^5$ with $K{\le}512$: $b^*$ 1946 fails; $3.2{\times}10^5$: $b^*$ BLER 0.749) and earlier V1 runs (incl. the $3.2{\times}10^5$ V1: BLER 0.995); new there: the $K{=}1024$ runs of $b^*$ (1906), the scalar-site $b^*$ (2071) and $b^*$ in V1's wiring (2027), V1-edge and V1-clamp. V1-edge was measured only at C1 $-3$\,dB (plus the report points C1 0\,dB and C5 $-6$\,dB, the latter outside the registered SNR grid (a pre-registered low-SNR extension point); report-only, Fig.~\ref{fig:k2_oog_rule}(c); apart from these, only the registered 40-trial C2 $-3$\,dB pre-check on development trials 2560..2599, where V1-edge and V1-clamp are bit-identical to V1, $n_{\rm oog}{=}0$), not at the decision points of C1 or C5, and only at $N_{\rm train}{=}1.6{\times}10^5$. The registered verdicts of cells C1 and C5 (table B, $N_{\rm train}{=}3.2{\times}10^5$, $b^*{\to}$V1: C1 GMM better at 3/3 decision points, +6/+9/+15\,dB; C5 not significant, GMM better at 1/3 and V1 at 1/3, +6/+12/+15\,dB) and the headline are unchanged.}

\par\smallskip\parbox{\textwidth}{\scriptsize V1-edge / V1-clamp: the registered primary / secondary variants of the out-of-grid query rule. BLER after 16 outer iterations; fails = failed blocks; a block whose arm raised is a block error; F3 guard: blocks in which the F3 guard fired; exc.: blocks whose arm raised. Gap position $(b^*-X)/(b^*-\mathrm{genie})$. $a{:}b$: $a$ = the first arm fails and the second succeeds, $b$ = the reverse; two-sided exact sign test on paired blocks. Roles: $^{\rm P}$registered primary test (decides); $^{\rm C}$test confirmation (run once by user decision); $^{\rm M}$mechanism check V1 frozen$\to$V1-edge (test: part of the registered confirmation; development: registered, report-only); $^{\rm W}$wiring-matched controls (registered, report-only, no verdict label); $^{\|}$registered report-only comparison, recorded three-way (clamp fewer failures / not decided / edge fewer failures); here: not decided ($n_d$, MDD, $|\Delta|$ in the caption); unmarked: report-only; blank: comparison not listed. Development $p$: $b^*{\to}X$ V1 frozen $9.0{\times}10^{-76}$, V1-edge $5.3{\times}10^{-4}$$^{\rm P}$, V1-clamp $4.7{\times}10^{-5}$; $X{\to}$V1-edge $1.7{\times}10^{-15}$$^{\rm W}$ (scalar site), $7.9{\times}10^{-12}$$^{\rm W}$ (V1's wiring), $8.3{\times}10^{-99}$$^{\rm M}$ (V1 frozen), $0.30$$^{\|}$ (V1-clamp). genie (R5): known-channel reference (same LMMSE-PIC/BCJR loop, true $H$), not a bound. $^{\dagger}$Share of blocks whose prior query has $\nu_q>\nu_{\rm hi}=1.4286$ (top of the $\sigma$ grid), at $t{=}1$ / over $t{=}2$--16. The score arms' iteration-1 query has $\nu_q=1.998$ in every recorded block; the two GMM arms with a scalar query level query at $\nu_q=2.190$ (GMM priors are closed form with no $\sigma$ grid; listed for the query level only). --: $b^*$ (exact site) and genie (R5) have no scalar query level $\nu_q$ (not recorded); genie has no F3 guard. 0.000 is rounded: V1-edge 1, $b^*$ scalar site 13, the others 0 of 38400 queries. $^{\S}$Over the frozen V1's 2246 recorded (non-raised) blocks; the registered report counts its 314 raised blocks (no $\nu_q$ record) as not above: 0.88 / 0.793.}
